name: Initial Gateway Pattern Topology
description: Introduces the foundational four-node API Gateway pattern linking api-consumer through api-gateway to api-producer and idp, then standardizes node-type classifications across all services.

name: Typed Interfaces and FINOS Namespace
description: Enriches api-gateway and api-producer with explicit interface definitions, aligns relationship wiring with Spectral validation rules, and migrates schema URIs from finos-labs to canonical finos namespaces.

name: Direct Consumer Identity Handshake
description: Adds the api-consumer-idp relationship so consumers authenticate directly against the Identity Provider before presenting tokens to api-gateway, while generalizing language-agnostic node names.

name: CALM Release Schema Standardization
description: Progressively upgrades interface schemas on api-gateway and api-producer from 2024-10 drafts through RC-1 candidates to stable CALM release specifications as legacy draft bundles are retired.
